description: Reads the unit, warranty terms and existing claims from the warranty sheet and decides whether a failure is covered. Read-only and safe to repeat. Returns status covered, not_covered, duplicate, unit_not_found, no_matching_terms or invalid_input, with a reason and the coverage figures.

unitNumber.description: The unit number as the technician gave it, such as T-1001.

mileage.description: The odometer reading in miles at failure.

partsCost.description: The parts cost in US dollars.
